title: The Unexpected Songbook
author: Astrid Blackwood
blurb: Mirabel Okonkwo, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
